name: mods
description: A panel that lists every mod with a switch for this session and one for all sessions, plus a control center (model, effort, stop), a session switcher and a done alert. Plain code: it makes no model calls of its own.

alert.title: Done alert
alert.description: When a turn that took a while ends, play a sound and mark the session's terminal.

alertSound.title: Alert sound
alertSound.description: The macOS system sound played when a turn ends; none plays nothing.

alertNotify.title: Mark the terminal
alertNotify.description: When a turn ends, notify through the terminal itself: its own notification where it has one, else its bell, which marks the session's tab.

alertAfterSeconds.title: Alert after (seconds)
alertAfterSeconds.description: Only alert when the turn took at least this many seconds.

chips.title: Quick buttons
chips.description: Show the mods, control and sessions buttons on the hint line under the prompt.
